topic: Lidar tracking issue on right lanes
summary_markdown:
Discussion focused on why the right lanes (r01, r02) stopped being tracked by a specific lidar unit starting November 17th. The current production configuration includes these areas, but historical data only shows records for them up to that date.

Initial suggestions included checking if the lane was closed for maintenance or removing the zones from the configuration file. It was noted that while the zone might have been removed from the config, it still exists in the production environment's code base. A suggestion was made to re-record a scene and compare it with old data to determine if the physical positions of the lanes have shifted.
decisions: No concrete decisions were reached regarding the cause or fix for the tracking issue.
action_items: Re-record a scene (3 minutes) and compare it with historical data to check for positional shifts in the lidar areas.
